newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates stable at mid-session.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates stable at mid-session.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates were stable at mid-session on Tuesday amid an absence of liquidity-upsetting factors, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate was at 5.160 percent against Monday's 5.152 close, with 30-day commercial paper staying flat at 5.15-5.20 percent.
Dealers expected the rates to hover around the current relatively low levels in the near term.
In the bond market, the 10-year 84/1 bond yield was at 6.0000 and the 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 6.1150-6.1175 against 6.0900. -- Rachel Lee (5080815)
